photos.file: Inga edulis, flower of the Icecream Bean (10108479523).jpg
photos.desc: Native to the northwestern Amazon basin where it is known as Guama. Now widely planted. Photo from the Colombian Amazon. In context at www.dixpix.ca/meso_america/Flora/mimosoid/index.html
Inga edulis in der Kaffeplantage. Der Baum wird in Kolumbien in Kakao-, Kaffee-, Tee- und Vanille-Plantagen als Schattenbaum angepflanzt.
